card.name: Endings of disease and condition names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical term, mostly the ending of tumor names (-oma) or condition names such as rhinitis, gestation and cancer, in indication or dosing text.

modes.label: Tumor name endings
modes.description: The closing -oma piece of cancer or tumor names.
modes.example: First-line maintenance treatment of germline BRCA -mutated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcin<<oma>>.

modes.label: Other condition endings
modes.description: The final piece of a condition name or a word like cancer before an indication or dose.
modes.example: The following doses for the treatment of symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinit<<is>> are recommended: For adults and adolescents

card.plain: It lights up as a long disease name finishes, especially tumor names ending in -oma.
